name: Chatbots and conversation design
description: Decisions a conversational system or a conversation designer makes at runtime or during review: intent routing, the dialogue act of the last user turn, the next repair move, the user's emotional state, the main flaw in a bot reply, and the outcome of a whole conversation. Some user turns are in Dutch, as they would be in a Dutch-language bot.

intent.instructions: Which intent best matches the user's last message to this banking assistant?

options.description: Wants to know how much money is in an account
Card is lost, stolen or must be blocked
Wants to send money or make a payment
Does not recognise or disagrees with a charge
Explicitly asks for a person or an employee
Not something a banking assistant handles

dialogue_act.instructions: What is the main dialogue act of the user's last turn in this conversation?

options.description: Gives information the bot asked for or needs
Asks the bot to do something or to provide information
Says yes or agrees with what the bot proposed
Says no or rejects what the bot proposed
Thanks the bot or ends the conversation
Expresses dissatisfaction with the bot or the service

next_move.instructions: What should the assistant do next in this conversation?

options.description: The request is clear and in scope: give the answer or perform the action
The request is ambiguous or missing a required detail
The request is clear but the action is consequential or irreversible
The user needs a person: explicit request, repeated failure, or a sensitive case
The user does not know what to say or what the bot can do

user_state.instructions: What is the emotional state of the user at the end of this conversation?

options.description: Neutral and cooperative
Unsure what is happening or what to do
Annoyed or impatient, but still engaging
Hostile, threatening to leave, or using strong language
Pleased or relieved

reply_flaw.instructions: Look at the bot's last reply. What is its main problem from a conversation design point of view?

options.description: The reply is appropriate
Does not address what the user actually asked
Tone does not fit the user's situation or emotion
Far more text or options than the user can process in a chat
Promises or states something the bot cannot know or guarantee

outcome.instructions: What is the outcome of this conversation?

options.description: The user's goal was achieved by the bot
The conversation was handed to a person
The user gave up or left without their goal being met
The conversation is still ongoing and the goal is open

items.question: reply_flaw
items.input:
User: how do I reset my password
Bot: There are several ways to reset your password depending on your account type, device, region and the security level you selected when you signed up. Option 1: if you have a personal account on desktop, go to Settings, then Security, then Credentials, then Password, then Reset, then confirm via email, SMS or authenticator. Option 2: if you have a business account, contact your administrator, who can reset it from the admin console under Users, Manage, Security, Credentials. Option 3: on mobile, open the app, tap the menu, tap Profile, tap Security, tap Password, tap Reset. Option 4: if you have lost access to your email address you need to verify your identity with a passport or ID card, which takes 5 to 10 working days. Option 5: if two-factor authentication is enabled, you also need your backup codes. Please also note our password requirements: at least 12 characters, one capital letter, one number, one special character, and it cannot be one of your last 10 passwords.
